summary: Crocs is american shoe company, founded in 2002. Type: listed company. About 7,907 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. insights.one_liner: Crocs, the US company behind Crocs and HEYDUDE footwear, runs its European entity from Hoofddorp and is an IND sponsor.

culture.text: About 7,907 people on LinkedIn, mostly in sales, operations, IT and marketing.
Staff often studied business, marketing or accounting, many at US schools like the University of Colorado Boulder.
Owns two brands, Crocs and HEYDUDE, and talks about comfort, personality and self-expression.

open.text: Crocs Europe B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one current job here, a director-level marketing role in Hoofddorp, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Crocs Europe B.V. is owned by Crocs, Inc. in the US.
Keeps launching collaborations, such as a Chainsaw Man clog collection.

worth_knowing.text: Crocs sued US retailer Five Below, accusing it of selling $7 knockoff clogs.
A report examined how Crocs uses Malta as a tax haven to shield profits.
